extracted.name: Hot Water Pie Crust
extracted.description: Forget everything you ‘ve heard about chilling your pie crust ingredients. This recipe uses boiling water and the pastry turns out flaky, manageable, and delicious.
instruction_lines: Combine shortening, salt, milk, and boiling water in a large bowl. Whisk with a fork until smooth and creamy.
Stir in flour until a soft dough forms and no dry streaks remain.
Divide dough in half and shape each portion into a disk. Use immediately to prepare one 9-inch double-crust pie or two 9-inch single-crust pies.
